<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Flows Portfolio</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#08090b;--card:#0f1114;--line:#ffffff1a;--tx:#ececee;--mu:#9b9fa7;--v:#d3d7de;--c:#8c97a6;--side:248px}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font:15px/1.6 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;color:var(--tx);min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#000 0%,#0b0c0e 40%,#1c1e22 100%)}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
*{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
body{user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none}
input{user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text}
img{pointer-events:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--c);outline-offset:2px}
.glass{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px}

#side{position:fixed;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:var(--side);padding:22px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;background:#0a0b0d;border-right:1px solid var(--line);z-index:20}
.logo{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;padding:4px 12px 18px}.logo span{color:var(--v)}
.nv{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;padding:11px 12px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:none;color:var(--mu);text-align:left;transition:background-color .2s,color .2s}
.nv img{width:22px;height:22px;object-fit:contain;filter:brightness(0) invert(1);opacity:.55;transition:opacity .2s,transform .15s}
.nv.on img{opacity:1;animation:pop .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.nv:active img{transform:scale(.8)}
@keyframes pop{0%{transform:scale(.6) translateY(5px)}55%{transform:scale(1.28) translateY(-4px)}100%{transform:scale(1) translateY(0)}}
@media(hover:hover){.nv:hover{background:#ffffff0d;color:var(--tx)}}
.nv.on{background:#ffffff17;color:#fff}
.nv.on:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-16px;top:10px;bottom:10px;width:3px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--v)}
.me{margin-top:auto;padding:12px;border-radius:14px;background:#ffffff08;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.me small{display:block;color:var(--mu);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:8px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.out{width:100%;padding:8px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:none;color:var(--mu);transition:background-color .2s,color .2s}
.out:hover{color:#fff;background:#ffffff0f}

#app{display:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;flex-direction:column;min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh}
#app>main{flex:1 0 auto;width:auto}
#app>footer{flex:none}
main{margin-left:var(--side);padding:48px clamp(20px,4vw,56px)}
.page{display:none;max-width:980px;margin:auto}
.page.on{display:block;animation:in .3s ease-out}
@keyframes in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}}
.badge{display:inline-block;padding:6px 13px;border-radius:99px;font-size:12px;color:#d3d7de;margin-bottom:16px}
h1{font-size:clamp(38px,6vw,68px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-2px}
h1 span{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff,var(--v),var(--c));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.lead{margin:20px 0 26px;color:var(--mu);font-size:17px;max-width:560px}
.title{font-size:34px;letter-spacing:-.5px}
.sub{color:var(--mu);margin:4px 0 26px}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:11px 18px;margin:0 8px 8px 0;border-radius:12px;font-weight:700;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#ffffff12;transition:transform .15s}
.btn.p{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f2f3f5,#a9afba);border-color:transparent;color:#0a0b0d}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:30px}
.pad{padding:18px}
.pad p{color:var(--mu);margin-top:10px;font-weight:600}
.box{padding:26px;color:#c9ccd2;line-height:1.8}

.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:16px}
.card{padding:18px;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s}
.card img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:14px;background:#0a0b0d}
.tag{display:inline-block;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:99px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;background:#ffffff14;color:var(--v)}
.tag.off{background:#ffffff12;color:var(--mu)}
.card p{color:var(--mu);font-size:14px;margin:6px 0 14px}
@media(hover:hover){.card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:#ffffff55}}

.sk{padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:12px}
.sk .t{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:600}
.sk em{font-style:normal;color:var(--mu);font-weight:400}
.bar{height:8px;border-radius:8px;background:#ffffff12;overflow:hidden}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--v),var(--c));transform:scaleX(var(--w));transform-origin:0 50%}
.page.on .bar i{animation:fill 1.1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) var(--d,0s) backwards}
@keyframes fill{from{transform:scaleX(0)}}

.lnk{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px 20px;margin-bottom:12px;font-weight:700;transition:transform .2s,background-color .2s}
.lnk img{width:40px;height:40px;object-fit:contain}
@media(hover:hover){.lnk:hover{background:#1a1c20;transform:translateX(4px)}}
footer{margin-left:var(--side);background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0a0b0d,#1c1e22 50%,#2e3136);text-align:center;padding:26px;color:#c9c9c9;font-size:13px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}

#auth{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;background:#07080af5;transition:opacity .3s}
.auth-card{width:min(430px,100%);padding:34px;border-radius:26px;animation:in .4s ease-out}
.auth-card h2{font-size:30px;margin-bottom:8px}
.auth-card p{color:var(--mu);font-size:14px}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:7px;margin:24px 0 16px}
.tab{flex:1;padding:11px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid transparent;background:#ffffff0d;color:#aaa}
.tab.active{background:#ffffff1f;border-color:#ffffff40;color:#fff}
.field{margin:14px 0}
.field label{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#aeb2b9;margin-bottom:7px}
.field input{width:100%;padding:13px 15px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #ffffff21;background:#0004;color:#fff;font:inherit;outline:none}
.field input:focus{border-color:#d3d7dec0}
.auth-btn{width:100%;margin-top:8px;padding:14px;border:0;border-radius:14px;color:#0a0b0d;font-weight:800;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f2f3f5,#a9afba)}
.message{min-height:20px;margin-top:12px;font-size:13px;text-align:center;color:#ff9eae}
.hint{margin-top:14px;text-align:center;color:#777;font-size:11px}

@media(max-width:800px){
#side{inset:auto 0 0 0;width:auto;flex-direction:row;padding:6px;gap:2px;border-right:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.logo{display:none}
.nv{flex:1;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:7px 2px;font-size:11px;text-align:center}
.nv.on:before{display:none}
.me{position:fixed;top:10px;right:10px;margin:0;padding:4px;background:#0a0b0d}.me small{display:none}.out{width:auto;padding:6px 12px}
main,footer{margin-left:0}main{padding:56px 18px 96px}footer{padding-bottom:90px}
.two{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.card img{aspect-ratio:1/1}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
.gif{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:14px;pointer-events:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none}
#bgvideo{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none;transform:translateZ(0);backface-visibility:hidden;will-change:transform}

/* sidebar minimize */
.sidetop{display:flex;align-items:center}
.mini{flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;width:32px;height:32px;margin-left:auto;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#ffffff0d;color:var(--mu);transition:background-color .2s,color .2s,transform .15s,width .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.mini svg{transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.mini:active{transform:scale(.88)}
@media(hover:hover){.mini:hover{background:#ffffff1a;color:#fff}}
.out{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.out svg{flex:none}
@media(min-width:801px){
#side{overflow:hidden;transition:width .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
main,footer{transition:margin-left .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.sidetop{margin-bottom:14px}
.logo{padding:4px 12px;max-width:160px;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;transition:max-width .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),padding .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),opacity .2s}
.nv{gap:0}
.lb{display:block;margin-left:12px;max-width:150px;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;transition:max-width .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),margin-left .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),opacity .25s}
.out .lb{margin-left:8px}
.me small{max-height:20px;transition:opacity .2s,max-height .4s,margin .4s}
body.min{--side:80px}
body.min .logo{max-width:0;padding-left:0;padding-right:0;opacity:0}
body.min #side .mini{width:48px}
body.min #side .mini svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
body.min .lb{max-width:0;margin-left:0;opacity:0}
body.min .me{padding:6px}
body.min .me small{opacity:0;max-height:0;margin:0}
}
@media(max-width:800px){
#side{transition:bottom .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.sidetop{position:absolute;right:12px;top:-42px}
.sidetop .mini{margin:0;background:#0a0b0d}
.mini svg{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
body.min #side{bottom:-72px}
body.min .mini svg{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.out svg{display:none}
}
/* MY EDIT popup */
#editBtn svg{vertical-align:-1px;margin-right:8px}
body.modal-open{overflow:hidden}
body.modal-open #bgvideo{visibility:hidden}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.92);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .3s ease,visibility 0s linear .3s}
.modal.open{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .3s ease}
.modal-card{position:relative;width:min(100%,720px,calc((100vh - 150px)*16/9 + 28px));width:min(100%,720px,calc((100dvh - 150px)*16/9 + 28px));padding:14px;transform:translateY(18px) scale(.94);transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.modal.open .modal-card{transform:none}
.modal-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:0 2px 12px 6px}
.modal-top h3{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--v)}
.modal-x{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#ffffff0d;color:var(--tx);transition:background-color .2s,transform .15s}
.modal-x:active{transform:scale(.9)}
@media(hover:hover){.modal-x:hover{background:#ffffff1f}}
.modal-card video{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:12px;background:#000;object-fit:contain}
.more{display:block;margin-top:12px;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#ffffff12;text-align:center;font-weight:700;transition:background-color .2s,transform .15s}
.more:active{transform:scale(.98)}
@media(hover:hover){.more:hover{background:#ffffff1f}}
</style></head><body>
<script>try{if(localStorage.getItem("flowsPortfolioSideMin")==="1")document.body.classList.add("min")}catch(e){}</script>
<video id="bgvideo" autoplay muted loop playsinline preload="auto" aria-hidden="true" disablepictureinpicture src="data:video/mp4;base64,"></video>
<script>(()=>{const v=document.getElementById("bgvideo");if(!v)return;const p=()=>{if(v.paused&&!document.body.classList.contains("modal-open"))v.play().catch(()=>{})};p();["click","touchstart","keydown"].forEach(e=>addEventListener(e,p,{once:true,passive:true}))})();</script>

</aside>

<script>
const A="flowsPortfolioAccount",SESSION="flowsPortfolioSession";
let mode="login";

function setMode(m){
  mode=m;
  loginTab.classList.toggle("active",m==="login");
  signupTab.classList.toggle("active",m==="signup");
  confirmWrap.style.display=m==="signup"?"block":"none";
  authBtn.textContent=m==="signup"?"Create Account":"Sign In";
  message.textContent="";
}

function showPage(n){
  const nx=document.getElementById("page-"+n);
  if(!nx)return;
  document.querySelectorAll(".page").forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle("on",p===nx));
  document.querySelectorAll(".nv").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("on",b.dataset.page===n));
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
document.querySelectorAll("[data-page]").forEach(el=>el.addEventListener("click",()=>showPage(el.dataset.page)));

function showPortfolio(u){
  startMusic();
  auth.style.opacity="0";
  setTimeout(()=>{
    auth.style.display="none";
    app.style.display="flex";
    welcomeUser.textContent="Hi, "+u;
    showPage("home");
    requestAnimationFrame(()=>app.style.opacity="1");
  },300);
}

function logout(){
  stopMusic();
  localStorage.removeItem(SESSION);
  app.style.opacity="0";
  setTimeout(()=>{
    app.style.display="none";
    auth.style.display="flex";
    auth.style.opacity="1";
    username.value=password.value=confirmPassword.value="";
    message.textContent="";
    updateAccountMode();
  },300);
}

function updateAccountMode(){
  const exists=!!localStorage.getItem(A);
  setMode(exists?"login":"signup");
  signupTab.style.display=exists?"none":"block";
}

authForm.onsubmit=e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const u=username.value.trim(),p=password.value,c=confirmPassword.value,saved=localStorage.getItem(A);
  if(!u||!p){message.textContent="Please enter your username and password.";return}
  if(mode==="signup"){
    if(saved){setMode("login");signupTab.style.display="none";message.textContent="An account already exists. Please sign in.";return}
    if(p.length<4){message.textContent="Password must be at least 4 characters.";return}
    if(p!==c){message.textContent="Passwords do not match.";return}
    localStorage.setItem(A,JSON.stringify({username:u,password:p}));
    localStorage.setItem(SESSION,"true");
    showPortfolio(u);return;
  }
  if(!saved){setMode("signup");signupTab.style.display="block";message.textContent="No account exists yet. Create one first.";return}
  const acc=JSON.parse(saved);
  if(u===acc.username&&p===acc.password){localStorage.setItem(SESSION,"true");showPortfolio(acc.username)}
  else message.textContent="Incorrect username or password.";
};

(function(){
  const saved=localStorage.getItem(A);
  if(saved&&localStorage.getItem(SESSION)==="true"){
    try{
      const acc=JSON.parse(saved);
      auth.style.display="none";
      app.style.display="flex";app.style.opacity="1";
      welcomeUser.textContent="Hi, "+acc.username;
      startMusic();
      return;
    }catch(e){localStorage.removeItem(A);localStorage.removeItem(SESSION)}
  }
  auth.style.display="flex";
  updateAccountMode();
})();

["contextmenu","selectstart","copy","dragstart"].forEach(ev=>addEventListener(ev,e=>{const t=e.target.nodeType===1?e.target:e.target.parentElement;if(!t||!t.closest("input,textarea"))e.preventDefault()}));

var evs=["pointerdown","keydown","touchstart"];
function unlockMusic(){document.getElementById("bgm").play().then(()=>evs.forEach(e=>removeEventListener(e,unlockMusic))).catch(()=>{})}
function startMusic(){
  const b=document.getElementById("bgm");
  if(!b){addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",startMusic,{once:true});return}
  b.volume=.5;
  b.play().catch(()=>evs.forEach(e=>addEventListener(e,unlockMusic,{passive:true})));
}
function stopMusic(){
  const b=document.getElementById("bgm");
  if(b){b.pause();b.currentTime=0}
  evs.forEach(e=>removeEventListener(e,unlockMusic));
}
</script>
<audio id="bgm" loop preload="auto" src="data:audio/mpeg;base64,"></audio>
<div id="editModal" class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="editTitle" aria-hidden="true"><div class="modal-card glass"><div class="modal-top"><h3 id="editTitle">MY EDIT</h3><button class="modal-x" id="editClose" type="button" aria-label="Close"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button></div><video id="editVideo" playsinline controls controlsList="nodownload noplaybackrate" disablepictureinpicture preload="none" src="data:video/mp4;base64,"></video><a class="more" href="https://vm.tiktok.com/ZS9DRMeokxwWR-6UFdE/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Show more</a></div></div>
<script>
(function(){
  const side=document.body,minBtn=document.getElementById("minBtn"),K="flowsPortfolioSideMin";
  function syncMin(){const m=side.classList.contains("min");minBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded",String(!m));minBtn.setAttribute("aria-label",m?"Expand sidebar":"Minimize sidebar");minBtn.title=m?"Expand":"Minimize"}
  syncMin();
  minBtn.addEventListener("click",()=>{side.classList.toggle("min");syncMin();try{localStorage.setItem(K,side.classList.contains("min")?"1":"0")}catch(e){}});
})();
(function(){
  const modal=document.getElementById("editModal"),vid=document.getElementById("editVideo"),
        bgm=document.getElementById("bgm"),bgv=document.getElementById("bgvideo"),
        openB=document.getElementById("editBtn"),closeB=document.getElementById("editClose");
  if(!modal||!vid||!openB)return;
  let active=false,resume=false;
  function musicOff(){if(active)return;active=true;resume=!!bgm&&!bgm.paused;if(bgm)bgm.pause()}
  function musicOn(){
    if(!active)return;active=false;
    if(resume&&bgm){resume=false;bgm.play().catch(()=>{if(typeof evs!=="undefined"&&typeof unlockMusic==="function")evs.forEach(e=>addEventListener(e,unlockMusic,{passive:true}))})}
  }
  if(bgm)bgm.addEventListener("play",()=>{if(active)bgm.pause()});
  vid.addEventListener("play",musicOff);
  vid.addEventListener("ended",musicOn);
  function openEdit(){
    modal.classList.add("open");modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");document.body.classList.add("modal-open");
    if(bgv)bgv.pause();
    musicOff();
    try{vid.currentTime=0}catch(e){}
    const p=vid.play();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(()=>{});
    closeB.focus({preventScroll:true});
  }
  function closeEdit(){
    vid.pause();try{vid.currentTime=0}catch(e){}
    modal.classList.remove("open");modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");document.body.classList.remove("modal-open");
    musicOn();
    if(bgv)bgv.play().catch(()=>{});
    openB.focus({preventScroll:true});
  }
  openB.addEventListener("click",openEdit);
  closeB.addEventListener("click",closeEdit);
  modal.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target===modal)closeEdit()});
  document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape"&&modal.classList.contains("open"))closeEdit()});
  document.addEventListener("focusin",e=>{if(modal.classList.contains("open")&&!modal.contains(e.target))closeB.focus({preventScroll:true})});
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  let ctx=null,master=null;
  function ac(){
    if(!ctx){
      const C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!C)return null;
      try{ctx=new C({latencyHint:"interactive"});master=ctx.createGain();master.gain.value=.9;master.connect(ctx.destination)}catch(e){ctx=null;return null}
    }
    if(ctx.state==="suspended")ctx.resume().catch(()=>{});
    return ctx;
  }
  function tone(o){
    const c=ac();if(!c)return;
    const t=c.currentTime+(o.delay||0),osc=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();
    osc.type=o.type;osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(o.f1,t);
    if(o.f2&&o.f2!==o.f1)osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(o.f2,t+o.dur);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(o.vol,t+.006);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+o.dur);
    osc.connect(g);g.connect(master);osc.start(t);osc.stop(t+o.dur+.03);
  }
  const S={
    pop(){tone({type:"sine",f1:420,f2:900,dur:.12,vol:.28});tone({type:"sine",f1:1260,f2:1260,dur:.07,vol:.07,delay:.025})},
    click(){tone({type:"triangle",f1:1700,f2:700,dur:.05,vol:.2});tone({type:"sine",f1:190,f2:120,dur:.07,vol:.25})}
  };
  window.tapSounds=S;
  ["pointerdown","touchstart","keydown"].forEach(e=>addEventListener(e,ac,{once:true,passive:true}));
  document.addEventListener("click",e=>{
    const el=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest("button,a,#side");if(!el)return;
    if(el.closest(".out")){S.click();return}
    if(el.closest("#side")||el.matches(".lnk")){S.pop();return}
    S.click();
  },true);
})();
</script>
